parsed.note_claim: Per official guidance issued on behalf of King Charles, Harry and Meghan are private citizens whose charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity and is not representative of the Sovereign.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The charitable work of the Duke and Duchess is a personal matter for them both and undertaken in their private capacity. In short, their position is akin to private citizens with commercial and charitable interests.
parsed.reason: The page reproduces the Lord Chamberlain's letter of guidance sent on behalf of the King, stating the Sussexes are no longer working royals, are akin to private citizens, and that their charitable work is undertaken privately.
